summary: Ran the full first test pass. Research repo: pytest 76/76 pass, ruff clean, mypy clean (48 files). The smoke profile ran end-to-end into /tmp/smoke_test and printed 'validation passed: True'. validate_results on results/aggregated/standard printed ALL CHECKS PASSED. Backend: 21/21 pytest pass covering overview, filters, conditions, series, pareto, tests, figures, the figure PNGs, path traversal (6 variants, all 404) and reproducibility. Frontend: all 6 tabs render with no console errors (Recharts gives only some ResponsiveContainer width(-1) warnings). Overview values match summary.json (255,960 rows; 8,532 conditions; 12,798 tests; H1/H2/H3/H5 SUPPORTED, H4 NOT SUPPORTED). Explorer filters, chart selects, stat selects, the 12 figures, the zoom modal, the toasts, the clipboard and the JSON download all work. Found 3 real issues: (1) choosing 'All' in the Explorer block filter still shows only the core block; (2) the Reproducibility tab is wider than the 390px mobile screen; (3) at 1920px desktop the tab nav overflows, so the Reproducibility tab is hidden until you scroll the nav.

minor.issue: Defaults are block='core' and reference='baseline'. A missing parameter means core/baseline, and only an empty string means all. Clients that leave out null params (axios does) can never ask for all blocks. Default block to None, or accept block=all.

ui_bugs.issue: Choosing 'All' in the block select gives null, and axios leaves the param out, so the backend falls back to block=core. Result: 1512 rows, same as core, when it should be 2268 for comparison A across all blocks. Confirmed via API: block= gives 2268, no param gives 1512.

The page scrollWidth is 579px at a 390px viewport. The grid column grows to fit the long run id, the platform string and the <pre> commands, so the cards and the Export button are cut off on the right. Fix: add min-w-0 to the grid children, plus break-all on reproducibility-run-id and the environment line.

In the max-w-7xl header, nav scrollWidth 831 > clientWidth 682. The 'Reproducibility' tab is off-screen and 'Publication Figures' is cut off until you scroll the nav, and the scrolled tabs slide under the subtitle text. Fix: shorten the subtitle, hide it below 2xl, or wrap the nav onto its own row.

issues: Rows are capped at limit=500 with no pagination or notice. For example, the header says 1512 conditions but only 500 rows are shown.
When filters return 0 rows (e.g. A + zne_richardson + worse_practical), the table and the count area are just blank. Add an empty-state message.
The 'Pareto frontier' legend entry has no icon because fill='none'. Use legendType='line' or set a stroke.
Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)' on the first render of ResponsiveContainer. This is harmless, but it can be fixed with minWidth={0} or initialDimension.

action_items: ExplorerTab: make block 'All' actually mean all blocks. Either send block='' explicitly, or change the backend default for block to None and make the frontend default 'core'.
ReproTab: add min-w-0 to the grid children and break-all/overflow handling on the run id, the environment line and the <pre> commands, so the 390px mobile view doesn't overflow.
Header: fix the desktop tab nav overflow at 1920px so all 6 tabs are visible without scrolling.
Optional: explorer pagination or a 'showing 500 of N' notice; an empty state on the stats table; a Pareto legend icon.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py filt(): int()/float() casts on query values are only safe because FastAPI types shots_per_circuit as int. Any future str-typed numeric filter would raise ValueError and return a 500.
server.py: the figures path check (resolve + parent + suffix) is solid. All 6 traversal variants returned 404.
lru_cache on CSV reads means a restart is needed if the viewer_data files change. This is fine for a read-only viewer.
Frontend data-testid coverage is good. The Select component uses native <select>, which is fine for this dashboard.

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 API tests; qem-bench 76/76 pytest, ruff, mypy, smoke and validate all pass)

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only app; no data modified. Smoke output written only to /tmp/smoke_test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Read-only viewer, no auth. Run the API tests with: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_qem_viewer_api.py. Do not touch /app/qem-bench/results or /app/backend/viewer_data. Retest: Explorer block 'All' (expect 2268 for A/no other filters), mobile 390px reproducibility tab scrollWidth == 390, desktop 1920px nav scrollWidth <= clientWidth.
